description: root CLAUDE.md is present and budgeted (< 150 lines)
command: [ -f CLAUDE.md ] && [ "$(wc -l < CLAUDE.md)" -lt 150 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: app/orders-api/CLAUDE.md scopes Python rules (pytest + the /healthz-not-/health trap)
command: [ -f app/orders-api/CLAUDE.md ] && grep -q 'pytest' app/orders-api/CLAUDE.md && grep -q '/healthz' app/orders-api/CLAUDE.md && echo pass || echo fail
[ -f app/inventory-api/CLAUDE.md ] && grep -q 'go test' app/inventory-api/CLAUDE.md && echo pass || echo fail
[ -f infra/CLAUDE.md ] && grep -Eq 'terraform (apply|destroy)' infra/CLAUDE.md && echo pass || echo fail
[ -f platform/CLAUDE.md ] && grep -q 'delete namespace' platform/CLAUDE.md && echo pass || echo fail

description: contracts/evidence-packet.yaml defines provenance fields (source, collected_at, trust)
command: [ -f contracts/evidence-packet.yaml ] && grep -q 'source:' contracts/evidence-packet.yaml && grep -q 'collected_at:' contracts/evidence-packet.yaml && grep -q 'trust:' contracts/evidence-packet.yaml && echo pass || echo fail
